Purrrrrrrr...

en:

en:

cz:

en:

cz:
Hele, chces se mnou spojit

en:

Just make sure you come back!
cz:
Co, chces toho nechat? Jak chces!
Jen se vrat!

en:
Look at that! A perfect fit!
That means good luck for us.
cz:
Koukej! Dokonale to sedi!
Znamena to stesti pro nas.

en:
You want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}?
I hope you've got one that fits!
cz:
Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?
Doufam, ze nejaky sedne!

en:
You want to quit? What do you hope
to gain by doing that?
cz:
Chces toho nechat? Co tim
chces ziskat?

en:
They fit perfectly. Why...I can
see my brother's smiling face...
cz:
Sedi to dokonale. Pani...
vidim usmev sveho bratra...

en:
You want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}?
Yeah, let's see if they fit!
cz:
Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?
Jo, uvidime, jestli sednou!

en:
Oh, you want to quit?
Is it me...?
cz:
Ach, chces toho nechat?
Jsem to ja...?

en:
They fit perfectly! Tingle would
be so proud of me!
cz:
Sedi to dokonale! Tingle by
na mne byl tak pysny!

en:
Let's {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
I hope they fit...
cz:
Pojdme {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}!
Doufam, ze sednou...

en:
Oh, you want to quit?
I see how it is...
cz:
Ach, chces toho nechat?
Uz chapu...

en:
Wow. I didn't actually think
that would work...
cz:
Pani. Vazne jsem necekal,
ze to vyjde...

Yes, please!
cz:

Ano, prosim!

What a shame...
cz:

Jaka skoda...

en:
They fit beautifully! This is a sign
of good things to come!
cz:
Sedi to krasne! To je znameni
veci pristich!

{Sound:01:F7}You want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}?
Sure, bring it on!
cz:
{Sound:01:F7}Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?
Jasne, do toho!

en:
Oh, what a shame...
You want to quit...
cz:
Ach, jaka skoda...
Ty toho chces nechat...

en:
Look at that! They fit perfectly! Well,
we're sure to get some good luck now!
cz:
Koukej! Sedi to dokonale!
Urcite nas ted ceka stesti!

{Sound:00:D5}You want to--BRRKAWK--{Color:Blue}fuse

cz:

BRRKAWK!

KOKODAK!

Kinstones{Color:White}? PEEP!

{Sound:00:D6}You want to quit... You think

en:
You want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}?
Sure, I bet we can do this!
cz:
Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?
Jasne, vsadim se, ze to dame!

en:
You want to quit?
Well, I'll be right here, waiting...
cz:
Chces toho nechat?
Budu tu cekat...

en:
OK!! Now we get happy!
See you later!
cz:
OK!! Ted se zaradujem!
Nashle!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}Hey! How'd you find me, kid?
You're a real humdinger!
So, since you found me, I'm going to
give you {Color:Red}my number-one treasure{Color:White}!
And keep up the good work!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Hej! Jak jsi me nasel, kluku?
Jsi ale frajer!
Kdyz jsi me nasel, dam ti
{Color:Red}svuj nejcennejsi poklad{Color:White}!
A jen tak dal!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}You came back!
I'm so happy! I was just getting lonely!
Except...I don't have anything else
to give you. Sorry!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Ty ses vratil!
Mam radost! Zacinal jsem byt sam!
Ale...nemam ti uz co dat.
Promin!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}So, have you met the {Color:Green}Great Fairy {Color:White}of
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}?
She lives right off that little side path!
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Potkal jsi {Color:Green}Velkou vilu {Color:White}z
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}?
Zije hned u te postranni stezky!

en:
{Sound:02:0D}And have you met the {Color:Green}Great Fairy {Color:White}of
{Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}?
She lives behind a wall that you have
to break open with a bomb.
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}A potkal jsi {Color:Green}Velkou vilu {Color:White}z
{Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}?
Zije za zdi, kterou musis
rozbit bombou.

en:
{Sound:02:0D}What about the {Color:Green}Great Fairy {Color:White}near
the {Color:Green}Royal Crypt{Color:White}? Have you met her?
She lives behind a wall that you have
to break open with a bomb.
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}A co {Color:Green}Velka vila {Color:White}u
{Color:Green}Kralovske krypty{Color:White}? Potkal jsi ji?
Zije za zdi, kterou musis
rozbit bombou.

en:
{Sound:00:D4}I found a--moo!--{Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White} in
this delicious grass.
Do you want to try {Color:Blue}fusing it
with one of mine{Color:White}? Moo...
I--moo--licked it until it was really
clean and shiny.
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Nasel jsem--buu!--{Color:Red}kousek Kamene{Color:White}
v te chutne trave.
Chces ho zkusit {Color:Blue}spojit s
mym{Color:White}? Buuu...
Olizal jsem ho--buu--dokud nebyl
cisty a lesknouci.

en:
{Sound:00:D4}This grass is delicious!
Moo... Want a nibble?
cz:
{Sound:00:D4}Tahle trava je vyborna!
Buuu... Chces kousnout?

en:
{Sound:00:D5}Well done of you to get here, BRRKAWK!

I have secretly taken possession of
{Color:Green}Anju{Color:White}'s {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}!
Hm? No, I didn't steal it, you rude boy!
I just borrowed it...secretly.
cz:
{Sound:00:D5}Hezky, ze jsi sem prisel, KOKODAK!

Tajne jsem se zmocnil
{Color:Green}Anju{Color:White}ina {Color:Red}kousku Kamene{Color:White}!
Hm? Ne, neukradl jsem ho, hrubiane!
Jen si ho pujcil...tajne.

en:
{Sound:00:D5}Wha--? The {Color:Red}Kinstone piece {Color:White}fused and
disappeared, BRRKAWK!
Now, I can't give it back to {Color:Green}Anju{Color:White}!
But I'm still happy, BRRKAWK!
cz:
{Sound:00:D5}Co--? {Color:Red}Kousek Kamene {Color:White}se spojil a
zmizel, KOKODAK!
Ted ho nemuzu vratit {Color:Green}Anju{Color:White}!
Ale stejne mam radost, KOKODAK!

en:
{Sound:00:D6}Eep! One of the Minish! PEEP!

I'm not like my brothers! I won't chase
you around and peck at you! Peepeep!
Not only that! I also have some good
info for you!
Somewhere in Hyrule, there's a {Color:Green}Great
Fairy{Color:White} who helps honest adventurers.
If you see her, answer her every
question truthfully! PEEP!
cz:
{Sound:00:D6}Pip! Jeden z Minish! PIP!

Nejsem jako bratri! Nebudu te honit
a klovat! Pippip!
A navic! Mam pro tebe i dobrou
zpravu!
Nekde v Hyrule je {Color:Green}Velka
vila{Color:White}, ktera pomaha poctivym dobrodruhum.
Kdyz ji uvidis, odpovez na vsechny
otazky pravdive! PIP!

en:
Wow... I just had the best idea! I can
rent out my house for some extra cash!
cz:
Pani... Mam skvely napad! Muzu
pronajimat dum a vydelat si!

en:
I'm feeling really motivated now!

I could probably build a good-sized
house in a matter of minutes!
cz:
Citim se ted vazne motivovany!

Postavil bych slusny dum
behem nekolika minut!

en:
My special {Color:Red}red potion {Color:White}is almost finished!
Oh, and it's so very special!
Heeheehee!
cz:
Muj specialni {Color:Red}cerveny lektvar {Color:White}je
temer hotov! A je tak vyjimecny!
Hihihi!

en:
Hey! I've just hit on a great idea!
This will add a little more risk!
Heh heh heh! I'm so excited!
I can't wait to get started!
cz:
Hej! Mam skvely napad!
Prida to trochu rizika!
Che che che! Tesim se!
Nemuzu se dockat!

en:
I really wish I could do more to help
people...
Wait! I've got it! I'll ask {Color:Green}Swiftblade {Color:White}to
start up a newsletter for adventurers!
That'll be a great way to provide
a useful service for everyone...
Hm. It's going to be a lot of work,
though. I should get {Color:Green}Marcy {Color:White}to help me.
cz:
Tak rad bych pomahal lidem vic...

Pockat! Uz to mam! Reknu {Color:Green}Swiftbladovi{Color:White},
aby zacal novinky pro dobrodruhy!
Bude to skvely zpusob, jak
poskytnout uzitecnou sluzbu...
Hm. Bude to ale spousta prace.
Potrebuju, aby mi {Color:Green}Marcy {Color:White}pomohla.

en:
You know what would be great? A bomb
that went off only when you wanted...
Hm... Actually, I think I could probably
make one with just a few minor tweaks!
cz:
Vis, co by bylo super? Bomba,
ktera vybuchne, jen kdyz chces...
Hm... Myslim, ze bych jednu
zvladl s par upravami!

en:
It's been a long time since the last time
I visited {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}...
I think I'll set up a little place
where I can sell my Kinstones.
cz:
Je to dlouho, co jsem byl
naposled v {Color:Green}Hyrule{Color:White}...
Myslim, ze si tu zrizu maly stanek,
kde budu prodavat Kameny osudu.

en:
{Sound:01:BE}I don't know why I've been such a
nasty little prankster all the time...
All of a sudden, I feel like a weight's
been lifted off my shoulders!
I feel like I've made up for all my
awful deeds! Haha!
Hey, {Color:Green}Spookter{Color:White}! See you in paradise!
cz:
{Sound:01:BE}Nevim, proc jsem byl porad takovy
sprostny vylomec...
Najednou citim, jako by ze me
spadl kamen!
Mam pocit, ze jsem odcinil sve
spatne skutky! Haha!
Hej, {Color:Green}Spookter{Color:White}! Uvidime se v raji!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}I feel so much stronger now!
Here we go!!!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Citim se ted o tolik silnejsi!
Jdem na to!!!

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Whew! It's about time... Looking good,
though! I'm going in!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Uf! Nejvyssi cas... Ale vypada
to dobre! Jdu dovnitr!

en:
{Sound:01:B9}Hn... No, it's no good...
I can't break it by myself.
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Hn... Ne, nejde to...
Sam to neprorazim.

en:
{Sound:01:B8}I had a strange feeling, like a fellow
Goron was in need... Hello? Goro?
Hn? That wall! You can't get through
that alone! I'm coming to help you!!!
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Mel jsem pocit, ze nejaky Goron
potrebuje pomoc... Halo? Goro?
Hn? Ta zed! Sam ji neprorazis!
Jdu ti pomoct!!!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}Don't worry! I'm here to help you! Let's
break through that wall together! Goro!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Neboj! Jsem tu, abych pomohl!
Prorazime tu zed spolu! Goro!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}Hn... This wall is pretty tough. I don't
think just the two of us can break it.
But that doesn't mean we're going
to stop trying! Goro!!!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Hn... Ta zed je dost tvrda.
Myslim, ze ji dva nezvladnem.
Ale to neznamena, ze prestaneme
zkouset! Goro!!!

en:
{Sound:01:B8}I thought I smelled some Gorons around
here! What are you guys up to?
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Myslel jsem, ze tu citim Gorony!
Co tady delate?

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Hey! Give us a hand breaking
through this wall! Goro!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Hej! Pomoz nam prorazit
tuhle zed! Goro!

en:
{Sound:01:B9}That's a tough wall! The three of us
together couldn't even break it...
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}To je tvrda zed! Ani my tri
dohromady jsme ji nezlomili...

en:
{Sound:01:B8}I smell delicious stones... They're right
on the other side of this wall.
cz:
{Sound:01:B8}Citim vyborne kameny... Jsou hned
za touhle zdi.

en: {Sound:01:B7}Can you give me a hand? Gorogoro?
cz: {Sound:01:B7}Pomuzes mi? Gorogoro?

en:
{Sound:01:B7}That's one solid wall... No doubt about
it. We're going to need some more help.
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}To je porad zed... Bez pochyb.
Budem potrebovat dalsi pomoc.

en:
{Sound:01:B9}Oooo... I can smell deliciousness just
on the other side of that wall.
cz:
{Sound:01:B9}Oooo... Citim vybornou vec hned
za tou zdi.

en: {Sound:01:B7}Oh, thank goodness! Help has arrived!
cz: {Sound:01:B7}Ach, diky bohu! Pomoc dorazila!

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Almost there... Goro! But it's
still just not breaking!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Skoro tam... Goro! Ale porad
se to nelama!

en:
{Sound:01:B7}I had a feeling there were some Gorons
in need of a little extra muscle.
Well, I'm here to help!
cz:
{Sound:01:B7}Mel jsem pocit, ze nejake Gorony
potrebuje trochu svalu navic.
Jsem tu pomoct!

en:
{Sound:01:BA}Hey, perfect timing! All right, everyone!
Together now! Gooooroooo!!!
cz:
{Sound:01:BA}Hej, perfektni nacasovani! Dobre,
vsichni! Spolecne! Gooooroooo!!!

en: A long, long time ago...
cz: Pred davnymi, davnymi casy...

en:
when the world was on the verge of
being swallowed by shadow...
cz:
kdyz byl svet na pokraji toho,
aby ho pohltil stin...

en:
The tiny Picori
appeared from the
sky, bringing the
hero of men a sword
and a golden light.
cz:
Malicti Picori
se zjevili z nebes
a prinesli hrdinovi
lidi mec a zlate
svetlo.

en:
With wisdom and
courage, the hero
drove out the
darkness.
cz:
S moudrosti a
odvahou hrdina
zahnal temnotu
pryc.

en:
When peace had been restored, the
people enshrined that blade with care.
cz:
Kdyz byl mir obnoven, lide ten
mec pecive ulozili.

en:
And the force of the golden light,
embodied in Hyrule's princess,
shone forth upon the lands.
cz:
A sila zlateho svetla,
vtelena do princezny Hyrule,
zarila nad zememi.

en:
{Sound:01:E8}Heh heh heh...
So that's what it means...
cz:
{Sound:01:E8}Che che che...
Takze to to znamena...

en: {Sound:00:95}Good morning, {Color:Green}Master Smith{Color:White}.
cz: {Sound:00:95}Dobre rano, {Color:Green}mistr Smith{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:00:C2}Goodness me! {Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White}!

Did you sneak out of the castle
and come all this way alone?
The minister is sure to be worried
about you! You know how he gets!
cz:
{Sound:00:C2}Pro pana krale! {Color:Green}Princezno Zeldo{Color:White}!

Vyplizila ses z hradu a
prisla az sem sama?
Ministr si bude jiste delat
starosti! Vis, jaky je!

en:
Oh, don't worry about him! He'll be fine.
Where's {Player}?
The whole town is bustling for the
annual {Color:Blue}Picori Festival{Color:White}!
I thought he and I might go together.
Would you mind terribly?
cz:
Ach, neboj se o nej! Zvladne to.
Kde je {Player}?
Cele mesto je v ruchu kvuli
kazdorocnimu {Color:Blue}Festivalu Piccoru{Color:White}!
Napadlo me, ze bychom mohli
jit spolu. Nevadi ti to?

en:
Oh, is that what you're here for? 

Well, {Player} was up late helping me
last night, and he's still asleep...
But I do have an errand at the
castle... Yes, that should be fine.
{07:10:05}
cz:
Ach, proto jsi tady? 

{Player} mi pomahal do pozdnich
hodin a jeste spi...
Ale mam pochuzku na hrade...
Ano, to by melo byt v poradku.
{07:10:05}

en: {Player}, time to get up!
cz: {Player}, je cas vstavat!

en:
{04:10:00}Hey! {Player}!

{Color:Green}Princess Zelda{Color:White} is here. She'd like to
know if you'd join her at the festival.
cz:
{04:10:00}Hej! {Player}!

{Color:Green}Princezna Zelda{Color:White} je tady. Pta se,
jestli s ni pujdes na festival.

en:
Yeah, {Player}. Come on! Let's
go check out the festival together!
{Color:Green}Master Smith{Color:White} already gave me
permission to take you!
cz:
Jo, {Player}. Pojd! Pojdme
spolu na festival!
{Color:Green}Mistr Smith{Color:White} uz mi dovolil,
abych te vzala!

en:
{04:10:00}Yes. After all, the festival only comes
once a year. Go on, have fun!
And while you're there, you can do me
a favor.
I just finished making this {Color:Red}sword {Color:White}for
the minister at {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}.
I'd like you to deliver it to him.
cz:
{04:10:00}Ano. Festival je prece jen jednou
rocne. Bavte se!
A kdyz uz tam budes, udelej
mi laskavost.
Prave jsem dokoncil tenhle {Color:Red}mec {Color:White}
pro ministra na {Color:Green}hradu Hyrule{Color:White}.
Chtel bych, abys mu ho dorucil.

en:
{04:10:00}This is the blade that will be presented
to the winner of the competition.
Don't lose it. And while the two of you
may be childhood friends, remember...
{07:10:0E}
cz:
{04:10:00}Tenhle mec bude predan
vitezi souteze.
Neztrat ho. A i kdyz jste kamaradi
z detstvi, pamatuj...
{07:10:0E}

en:
Master Smith, quit worrying! We'll be
perfectly safe.
Come on, {Player}! Let's go
check out the festival!
cz:
Mistre Smithe, neboj se! Budem
v naprostem bezpeci.
Pojd, {Player}! Pojdme
na festival!

en:
{04:10:00}Zelda is the princess of Hyrule.

You watch over her. Don't let
anything bad happen to her.
cz:
{04:10:00}Zelda je princezna Hyrule.

Davej na ni pozor. At se
ji nic spatneho nestane.

en: {Sound:00:94}{Player}! Over here!
cz: {Sound:00:94}{Player}! Sem!

en:
Come on, {Player}. Let's hurry
to the castle.
cz:
Pojd, {Player}. Pospesme
na hrad.

en:
{Sound:00:95}{Player}!
Hurry! Let's go!
cz:
{Sound:00:95}{Player}!
Pospes! Jdeme!

en:
Over here! Come on!
Hurry up!
cz:
Sem! Pojd!
Pospes si!

en: Well, here we are! The {Color:Green}town of Hyrule{Color:White}!
cz: Tak, a jsme tady! {Color:Green}Mesto Hyrule{Color:White}!

en: We have a winner!
cz: Mame vitezku!

en:
Oh, my! Princess Zelda! You won the
grand prize in our drawing? Wow!
You get your choice of any of these
wonderful prizes. What will it be?
cz:
Ach! Princezna Zelda! Vyhrala jsi
hlavni cenu v nasi loterii? Pani!
Muzes si vybrat kteroukoliv z
techto skvelych cen. Kterou?

en:
First, we have...this lovely
{Color:Red}heart-shaped stone{Color:White}!
Next, we have...
cz:
Nejdriv mame...tenhle krasny
{Color:Red}kamen ve tvaru srdce{Color:White}!
Dal mame...

en:
this {Color:Red}magnificent gem{Color:White}!
And finally, there's...
cz:
tenhle {Color:Red}nadherny drahokam{Color:White}!
A nakonec mame...

en: this teeny-tiny {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}.
cz: tenhle malicky {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}.

en:
So, which one would you like?

Let me guess...the jewel? Oh, but this
heart stone is very cute, too.
Choose whichever one you like!
cz:
Tak, ktery chces?

Hadam...drahokam? Ach, ale ten
kamen-srdce je take roztomily.
Vyber si, kterykoli chces!

en:
The {Color:Red}shield {Color:White}is so adorable! I think
I'll take it.
cz:
Ten {Color:Red}stit {Color:White}je tak roztomily!
Myslim, ze si vezmu jeho.

en:
What!? Why? Why would you want that
ugly thing!?
What about the heart stone! It's cute!

Or... Or this giant gem! It's pretty!

Honestly, they're both much nicer than
that nasty little shield thing.
cz:
Coze!? Proc? Proc bys chtela
tu osklivost!?
A co kamen-srdce! Je rozkosny!

Nebo... Nebo ten obrovsky drahokam!
Je krasny!
Uprimne, oba jsou mnohem hezci
nez ta osklivost-stit.

en:
Nope! I want the {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}.
Can I have it?
cz:
Ne! Chci ten {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}.
Muzu ho dostat?

en:
What a strange princess you are.
Well...
OK. Here's your teeny-tiny {Color:Red}shield{Color:White}.
cz:
Jsi ale podivna princezna.
No...
OK. Tady je tvuj malicky {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}.

en:
Here! I want to give you a present!

Doesn't this {Color:Red}shield{Color:White} suit you perfectly,
{Player}?
cz:
Tady! Chci ti dat darek!

Nesedne ti tenhle {Color:Red}stit{Color:White} dokonale,
{Player}?

en:
Yep! Just as I thought! You look great!

Now, if anything happens, you can
protect me with that shield!
Oh! I almost forgot! We have to {Color:Blue}take
Master Smith's sword to the castle{Color:White}.
Let's go, {Player}.
cz:
Jo! Presne, jak jsem myslela!
Vypadas skvele!
Kdyz se neco stane, muzes me
tim stitem chranit!
Ach! Skoro jsem zapomnela! Musime
{Color:Blue}odnest mistruv mec na hrad{Color:White}.
Pojdme, {Player}.

en:
{04:10:0C}{Sound:00:A9}Oh! {Player}! You brought the
sword, did you?
Then, as minister to the kingdom of
Hyrule, I, {Color:Green}Potho{Color:White}, accept this blade.
You came just in time. The award
ceremony will begin soon.
cz:
{04:10:0C}{Sound:00:A9}Ach! {Player}! Prinesl jsi ten
mec, ze?
Jako ministr kralovstvi Hyrule
ja, {Color:Green}Potho{Color:White}, prijimam tento mec.
Prisel jsi prave vcas. Slavnostni
ceremonie zacne brzy.

en:
{Sound:00:94}{04:10:0C}I'm sorry, {Player}, but I'd better go.
I have to prepare for the ceremony.
I had a good time at the festival.
Thanks for coming with me!
cz:
{Sound:00:94}{04:10:0C}Promin, {Player}, ale musim jit.
Musim se pripravit na ceremonii.
Mela jsem na festivalu pekny cas.
Dik, ze jsi sel se mnou!

en:
Since you're here, {Player}, why don't
you join us for the award ceremony?
cz:
Kdyz uz jsi tady, {Player}, proc
se nepridas k slavnostni ceremonii?

en:
Do you know about {Color:Red}that sword{Color:White},
{Player}?
It is called the {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}, and it
locks much evil away in that chest.
The {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White} is sacred among the
people of Hyrule.
The legend has it that, long ago, the
{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} gave us this blade.
Whoever wins the competition earns the
honor of touching the sacred blade.
cz:
Vis o {Color:Red}tom meci{Color:White},
{Player}?
Jmenuje se {Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White} a zamyka
v te truhle mnoho zla.
{Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White} je posvatna pro
obyvatele Hyrule.
Legenda pravi, ze davno {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}
nam dali tenhle mec.
Kdo vyhraje soutez, ziska cest
dotknout se posvatneho mece.

en:
{Sound:01:F2}Let the award ceremony commence!

{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}, champion of the competition,
you may approach the blade!
cz:
{Sound:01:F2}At ceremonie zacne!

{Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}, sampione souteze,
muzes pristoupit k cepeli!

en:
{Sound:00:AA}Ah! Princess Zelda!! Wh--
When did you leave the castle?!
cz:
{Sound:00:AA}Ach! Princezno Zeldo!! K--
Kdy jsi opustila hrad?!

en: {Sound:00:AA}Welcome to {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}!
cz: {Sound:00:AA}Vitej na {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}!

en:
Sorry, but we're getting things ready
for the ceremony. I can't let you pass.
cz:
Promin, ale chystame ceremonii.
Nemuzu te pustit.

en:
Preparations for the award ceremony
are coming along nicely.
cz:
Pripravy na slavnostni ceremonii
idou pekne kupredu.

en:
Sorry, but I can't let you pass. We've
sealed the area off because of {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}.
cz:
Promin, nemuzu te pustit. Oblast
jsme uzavreli kvuli {Color:Green}Vaatimu{Color:White}.

en:
Ah, the sword for the award ceremony!
You should take that to {Color:Green}Minister Potho{Color:White}.
You'll find him in front of the castle.
cz:
Aha, mec pro ceremonii! Mel bys
ho odnest {Color:Green}ministru Pothovi{Color:White}.
Najdes ho pred hradem.

en:
Heh heh heh...

To think things would go this well!

The {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White} and the Bound Chest
spoken of in Hylian lore...
This chest must hold that which I seek!
I'll relieve you of its contents now.
cz:
Che che che...

Aby to slo tak dobre!

{Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White} a spoutana Truhla
z hylianskych legend...
Ta truhla musi obsahovat to, co
hledam! Zbavim te obsahu.

en:
{Sound:00:9B}Mmmm ah hah hah hah!
Do not interfere with me...
As victor, I've earned the right to
approach the {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}...
I've been waiting for this moment!
cz:
{Sound:00:9B}Mmmm cha cha cha!
Nezasahujte do me cesty...
Jako vitez jsem ziskal pravo
pristoupit k {Color:Red}Picori cepeli{Color:White}...
Na tuto chvili jsem cekal!

en: Who are you? Why are you doing this?
cz: Kdo jsi? Proc to delas?

en:
The princess with the {Color:Blue}mystic aura{Color:White}...

...The power that was gifted to the
people of Hyrule still flows
within the veins of the ladies
of its royal family? Interesting...
If I leave you now, you'll only cause
me trouble later. That will never do.
cz:
Princezna s {Color:Blue}mystickou aurou{Color:White}...

...Sila, ktera byla darovana
obyvatelum Hyrule, stale plyne
v zilach dam kralovske rodiny?
Zajimave...
Kdyz te ted necham, jen mi pak
zpusobis potize. To nepujde.

en: To stone with you!
cz: Promen se v kamen!

en:
{Player}! Watch out!
{09:00}
cz:
{Player}! Pozor!
{09:00}

en:
...?!?

Empty? There was nothing in there
but a rabble of monsters?
What is the meaning of this?

Well, I know the {Color:Red}force{Color:White} I'm after is
somewhere out there.
I'm in no hurry. I can take my
time searching for it.
{Sound:00:9B}Heh heh heh...
cz:
...?!?

Prazdne? Nebylo tam nic krome
bandy priser?
Co to ma znamenat?

Vim, ze {Color:Red}sila{Color:White}, kterou hledam, je
nekde venku.
Nespecham. Muzu si dat na
hledani cas.
{Sound:00:9B}Che che che...

en:
Heh heh heh heh... All who stand
in my way shall share this fate!
Now, to find out what power awaits
me in this chest!
cz:
Che che che che... Vsichni, kdo
mi stoji v ceste, sdileji tento osud!
A ted zjistim, jaka sila na me
v te truhle ceka!

en: Eeeeeeeek!
cz: Iiiiiiiii!

en:
{Sound:00:A3}It is as you have all heard.

A sorcerer named {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White} has cursed my
fair Zelda and turned her to stone.
If we had the sacred {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}, we
likely could have broken the curse.
But Vaati shattered the blade...

However, I have not given up hope.
What do you know about the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}?
cz:
{Sound:00:A3}Je to tak, jak jste vsichni slyseli.

Carodej jmenem {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White} proklel mou
milou Zeldu a promenil ji v kamen.
Kdybychom meli posvatnou {Color:Red}Picori
cepel{Color:White}, mohli jsme prokleti zlomit.
Ale Vaati cepel rozbil...

Presto jsem neztratil nadeji.
Co vis o {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}?

en:
The {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}? Not much, beyond what the
fairy tales say...
They're supposed to be very tiny, if I'm
remembering correctly.
cz:
{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}? Moc ne, krome toho, co
rikaji pohadky...
Maji byt velmi malicti, jestli
se dobre pamatuji.

en:
Yes, the ones from the fairy tales...

But the Picori are no mere legend.
They most certainly exist.
No one outside of the royal family
knows the truth about them.
The Picori, who forged the sacred
blade, live deep within {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}.
They should be able to repair the
broken blade and reforge the sword.
cz:
Ano, ti z pohadek...

Ale Picori nejsou jen legenda.
Urcite existuji.
Nikdo mimo kralovskou rodinu
nezna pravdu o nich.
Picori, kteri ukovali posvatnou
cepel, ziji hluboko v {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}.
Meli by byt schopni opravit
rozbitou cepel a prekovat mec.

en:
Wh-What!? Then we must dispatch the
soldiers there at once!
cz:
C-Co!? Pak tam musime ihned
vyslat vojaky!

en:
No, soldiers will not do.

The Picori do not show themselves
to anyone but children.
Our soldiers could search for days
and still find no sign of them.
cz:
Ne, vojaci nepostaci.

Picori se neukazuji nikomu
jinemu nez detem.
Nasi vojaci by mohli hledat
dny a nenasli by po nich stopu.

en:
I see...

If that's the case, then why not
send {Player}?
cz:
Aha...

Kdyz je to tak, proc
nevyslat {Player}a?

en:
{Sound:01:EB}If {Player} has recovered, then yes,
I would like to ask this of him.
Please, turn my precious Zelda back
to normal.
The {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} should know how to create a
new {Color:Red}sacred sword{Color:White}.
It will be a dangerous journey, now
that those monsters have been freed.
Please, take this sword with you,
along with the broken {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:01:EB}Kdyz se {Player} zotavil, ano,
rad bych ho o to pozadal.
Prosim, vrat mou drahou Zeldu
zpet do normalu.
{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} by meli vedet, jak vytvorit
novy {Color:Red}posvatny mec{Color:White}.
Bude to nebezpecna cesta, kdyz
ty prisery byly osvobozeny.
Prosim, vezmi si tento mec
i rozbitou {Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White}.

en:
Very well, then. Send the soldiers to
search for {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White} at once!
cz:
Velmi dobre. Vyslete vojaky,
at ihned hledaji {Color:Green}Vaatiho{Color:White}!

en:
Deep within the {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}, you will
find a place called {Color:Green}Deepwood Shrine{Color:White}.
Once, humans and {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} shared that
shrine as a meeting place.
I think it would be best if you
started your search there.
cz:
Hluboko v {Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} najdes
misto zvane {Color:Green}Deepwood Shrine{Color:White}.
Kdysi tam lide a {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White} mivali
setkani.
Myslim, ze bys mel hledani
zacit tam.

en:
Take this {Color:Red}map {Color:White}with you.

{07:10:5E}
cz:
Vezmi si tuto {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}.

{07:10:5E}

en:
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} lies southeast
of the town of Hyrule.
In fact, it's due east of your
house, {Player}.
cz:
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} leze jihovychodne
od mesta Hyrule.
Vlastne hned na vychod od
tveho domu, {Player}.

en:
Oh, {Player}. You're awake. Are you
feeling all right?
Stand at my side. The king of
Hyrule is about to speak.
cz:
Ach, {Player}. Probudil ses. Citis
se dobre?
Stuj po mem boku. Kral
Hyrule bude mluvit.

en:
I am counting on you, {Player}.

Only you can break {Color:Blue}Vaati's curse
{Color:White}and free Princess Zelda.
cz:
Pocitam s tebou, {Player}.

Jen ty muzes zlomit {Color:Blue}Vaatiho kletbu
{Color:White}a osvobodit princeznu Zeldu.

en:
If you get lost on your way to the
forest, simply check your map.
Just press START and then {Key:Left} or
{Key:Right} to open the map.
I've marked the location of the forest
for you. Good luck, and be careful.
cz:
Kdyz se ztratis cestou do lesa,
staci se podivat na mapu.
Stiskni START a pak {Key:Left} nebo
{Key:Right}, abys mapu otevrel.
Oznacil jsem ti polohu lesa.
Hodne stesti a buc opatrny.

en:
Master Smith is here as well. He's come
to see His Majesty the king.
cz:
Mistr Smith je tu take. Prisel
za Jeho Velicenstvem kralem.

en:
Please find a way to break the curse
on Princess Zelda.
cz:
Prosim, najdi zpusob, jak zlomit
kletbu na princezne Zelde.

en: Please be careful!
cz: Prosim, bud opatrny!

en:
There are monsters outside the castle.

If you see one, use your {Color:Red}shield{Color:White} to
defend yourself.
Move in close enough to use your {Color:Red}sword{Color:White}
if you need to fight.
cz:
Venku za hradem jsou prisery.

Kdyz nejakou uvidis, pouzij {Color:Red}stit{Color:White}
k obrane.
Pribliz se dostatecne, abys mohl
pouzit {Color:Red}mec{Color:White}, kdyz potrebujes bojovat.

en:
{Sound:01:E0}Owwwwch!

That must be the {Color:Green}Business Scrub{Color:White} I
heard the soldiers talking about.
They were saying a Deku Scrub had
been hassling all the passersby.
{Player}, do something about it!
Otherwise, we can't get to the castle.
If only we had some way to defend
ourselves against {Color:Blue}those nuts of his{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:01:E0}Au!

To musi byt ten {Color:Green}Business Scrub{Color:White},
o kterem vojaci mluvili.
Rikali, ze Deku Scrub otravuje
vsechny kolemjdouci.
{Player}, udelej s tim neco!
Jinak se nedostaneme na hrad.
Kdybychom meli, cim se branit
proti {Color:Blue}tem jeho orechum{Color:White}.

en:
If we could just defend against those
{Color:Blue}nuts{Color:White}, I'm sure we could do something!
cz:
Kdybychom se mohli branit
{Color:Blue}tem orechum{Color:White}, urcite bychom neco zmohli!

en:
I actually feel a little sorry for that
Business Scrub. But that nut hurt!
Oh, well. He won't be hassling anyone
now! We'd better hurry to the castle!
cz:
Vlastne mi je toho Business
Scruba trochu lito. Ale ten orech bolel!
No nic. Uz nebude nikoho otravovat!
Musime spechat na hrad!

en:
Where are you going, {Player}?
Hurry up and do something!
cz:
Kam jdes, {Player}?
Pospes si a udelej neco!

en:
Please! Forgive me, sir!

I heard there was a {Color:Blue}festival{Color:White}, and I
came to {Color:Green}town {Color:White}hoping to hawk my wares.
Unfortunately, we scrubs have a
tendency to spit nuts when we speak!
Everyone got scared and ran away,
and no one would buy anything!
This is a terrible place to do
business! I'm going back to my cave!
cz:
Prosim! Odpustte mi, pane!

Slysel jsem, ze je {Color:Blue}festival{Color:White}, a
prisel do {Color:Green}mesta {Color:White}prodavat zbozi.
Bohuzel my scrubove mame sklon
plivat orechy, kdyz mluvime!
Vsichni se vylekli a utekli,
nikdo nic nekoupil!
Tohle je hrozne misto pro obchod!
Vracim se do sve jeskyne!

en: All right! To the {Color:Green}castle {Color:White}we go!
cz: Dobre! Jdeme na {Color:Green}hrad{Color:White}!

en:
Even turned to stone by {Color:Blue}Vaati's
curse{Color:White}, her eyes are filled with life.
Hurry... Save her...
cz:
I kdyz je promenena v kamen
{Color:Blue}Vaatiho kletbou{Color:White}, oci ma plne zivota.
Pospes... Zachran ji...

en: Helllllp!!! Help meeee!!!
cz: Pomocccc!!! Pomozte miii!!!

en: Ouch! Won't somebody stop them!?
cz: Au! Nezastavi je nekdo!?

en:
Ow! Ow! Help... Somebody!
Can't anybody hear me?
cz:
Au! Au! Pomoc... Nekdo!
Neslysi me nikdo?

en: OUCH!!!
cz: AU!!!

en: {Sound:00:92}Hey! Kid! You there!
cz: {Sound:00:92}Hej! Kluku! Ty tam!

en: Ow!
cz: Au!

en:
Hey! Don't just stand there!
Do something!!!
cz:
Hej! Nestuj jen tak!
Udelej neco!!!

en: Ow!
cz: Au!

en:
What's wrong with you!? Do you like
watching me take this abuse!? Help me!
cz:
Co je s tebou!? Bavi te koukat
se, jak me biji!? Pomoz mi!

en:
{Sound:00:90}Phew! Well done! That was close. Not
that I couldn't handle them myself.
But that's beside the point!

What in the world is a lone child
doing so deep in the woods?
cz:
{Sound:00:90}Uf! Dobra prace! Bylo to tesne.
Ne ze bych je sam nezvladl.
Ale to neni podstatne!

Co tu osamele dite dela tak
hluboko v lesich?

en: Ho ho! I see.
cz: Ho ho! Aha.

en: The...{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}, you say? And {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}?
cz: ...{Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}, rikas? A {Color:Green}Vaati{Color:White}?

en:
Vaati's cursed someone? What?
The sacred blade?!?
cz:
Vaati nekoho proklel? Co?
Posvatnou cepel?!?

en:
Is that so? I see, I see... You know,
you and I have quite a lot in common.
You see, I, too, am on a quest to
break a curse of Vaati's.
And you say that reforging the {Color:Red}sacred
blade{Color:White} can break his curse, eh?
Well, then you have found yourself
a companion, my boy!
My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}. It's a pleasure to
make your acquaintance.
cz:
Vazne? Aha, aha... Vis, mame
spolu hodne spolecneho.
Ja take putuji, abych zlomil
jednu Vaatiho kletbu.
A rikas, ze prekovani {Color:Red}posvatne
cepele{Color:White} muze kletbu zlomit?
No, pak jsi nasel spolecnika,
muj chlapce!
Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}. Tesim se na
spolecnou cestu.

en:
{Sound:00:92}Wait! Wait, I say!

You walk so quickly!
Too quickly, in fact!
Can't you go any slower? Surely
you've noticed that I have no legs...
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Pockej! Pockej, povidam!

Chodis tak rychle!
Moc rychle, vskutku!
Nemuzes pomaleji? Urcite sis
vsiml, ze nemam nohy...

en:
{Sound:00:92}Boy! Take a good look at me! Do you
really think I can walk that fast!?
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Kluku! Poradne se na me podivej!
Vazne myslis, ze chodim tak rychle!?

en:
{Sound:01:E4}Augh!

If it isn't one thing, it's another!
You are a troublesome boy!
cz:
{Sound:01:E4}Ach!

Kdyz ne jedna vec, tak druha!
Jsi otravny kluk!

en:
{Sound:00:5F}There! Now, you can't possibly
leave me behind.
My... It's quite comfortable up here.
More comfortable than it looks, surely.
And much easier on me!

Hey! Quit your squirming! Can't
you sit still? See! There...
Yes, yes! That's it. Much better.

Now, I suppose a boy like you still has
much to learn about the world.
If ever you need my insight, press
{Color:Blue}SELECT{Color:White}. I'll be happy to help!
Ah, such a hopeless child...
cz:
{Sound:00:5F}Tak! Ted me uz nemuzes
nechat za sebou.
Mujm... Tady nahore je to pohodlne.
Pohodlnejsi nez to vypada, vskutku.
A pro me mnohem snazsi!

Hej! Prestan se vrtet! Nevydrzis
v klidu? Tak... Tady...
Ano, ano! To je ono. Mnohem lepsi.

Kluk jako ty se ma jeste
hodne co ucit o svete.
Kdy budes potrebovat radu, stiskni
{Color:Blue}SELECT{Color:White}. Rad ti pomohu!
Ach, takove bezradne dite...

en:
Hey! Where are you going?
You heartless brat! Help me!!!
cz:
Hej! Kam jdes?
Bezsrdcaty parchant! Pomoz mi!!!

en:
What are you doing? Aren't you going
to finish them off?
cz: Co delas? Nedoraz je?

en:
...What? Is there something on my
face? Quit staring! It's rude!
cz:
...Co? Mam neco na oblicej?
Prestan civet! Je to hrubost!

en:
Oh, {Player}. You're heading for
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White} now, aren't you?
Leave the monsters that {Color:Green}Vaati
{Color:White}freed to us, and go find the {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}!
cz:
Ach, {Player}. Mirilis ted do
{Color:Green}Minish Woods{Color:White}, ze?
Prenech prisery, ktere {Color:Green}Vaati
{Color:White}osvobodil, nam a najdi {Color:Green}Picori{Color:White}!

en:
{Color:Green}Minish Woods {Color:White}lie far to the south from
here. If you get lost, check your {Color:Red}map{Color:White}.
cz:
{Color:Green}Minish Woods {Color:White}lezi daleko na jih
odtud. Kdyz se ztratis, mrkni na {Color:Red}mapu{Color:White}.

en:
Hey, kid! Where are you going!?
That's the way we just came from!
cz:
Hej, kluku! Kam jdes!?
Odtud jsme prave prisli!

en:
You who desire to enter the realm of
the Minish, seek out the hidden portal.
Offer up your song at the portal's
base, and be guided to the world below.
cz:
Ty, kdo touzis vstoupit do rise
Minish, hledej skryty portal.
Obetuj svou pisen u zakladu
portalu a budes veden dolu.

en:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... It appears we have found the
{Color:Green}Minish village{Color:White}.
cz:
{Sound:00:8E}Hmmm... Zda se, ze jsme nasli
{Color:Green}vesnici Minish{Color:White}.

en: {Sound:00:B1}Pico picori!
cz: {Sound:00:B1}Pico picori!

en: {Sound:00:B3}Ripi ripico picori!
cz: {Sound:00:B3}Ripi ripico picori!

en: {Sound:00:B2}Picoco pico ripico!
cz: {Sound:00:B2}Picoco pico ripico!

en:
I gather it's been quite some time
since they last saw a human.
...What's that? You didn't understand
what they were saying just now?
Ah, yes. That was the language
of the {Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
It's a little different from the dialect
I am most familiar with.
I'm afraid I didn't catch most
of what they said myself.
But perhaps there is someone here
who {Color:Blue}understands your language{Color:White}.
We should look around.
cz:
Hadam, ze je to dost dlouho,
co naposled videli cloveka.
...Coze? Ty jsi nerozumel
tomu, co prave rikali?
Ach, ano. To byl jazyk
{Color:Green}Minish{Color:White}.
Lisi se trochu od dialektu,
ktery znam nejlepe.
Obavam se, ze jsem vetsinu
ani sam nepostrehl.
Ale mozna je tu nekdo, kdo
{Color:Blue}rozumi tvemu jazyku{Color:White}.
Podivame se kolem.

en:
Fortunately, the {Color:Red}Earth Element {Color:White}is in the
{Color:Green}shrine {Color:White}at the far end of the village.
A horde of beasts lives in that {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White},
though, so enter with caution.
cz:
Nastesti je {Color:Red}Element zeme {Color:White}ve
{Color:Green}svatyni {Color:White}na konci vesnice.
V te {Color:Green}svatyni{Color:White} vsak zije horda
selem, takze vstup s opatrnosti.

en:
{Sound:02:0D}Oh! You speak our language!

It's been quite a while since we've
heard outsiders speak our tongue!
We have little to offer you in these
woods, but please, enjoy your stay.
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Ach! Mluvis nasim jazykem!

Uz je to dlouho, co jsme slyseli
cizince mluvit nasi reci!
Mame malo co nabidnout v techto
lesich, ale prosim, uzij si pobyt.

en:
Thank you for your offer, but we have
no time to relax. My name is {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}.
This child is {Player}.

We need to break a {Color:Blue}curse {Color:White}that has
been cast on the princess of Hyrule.
To do so, we'll need to reforge
the broken {Color:Red}Picori Blade{Color:White}.
cz:
Dekuji za nabidku, ale nemame
cas odpocivat. Jmenuji se {Color:Green}Ezlo{Color:White}.
Toto dite je {Player}.

Musime zlomit {Color:Blue}kletbu{Color:White}, ktera byla
uvalena na princeznu Hyrule.
Kvuli tomu musime prekovat
rozbitou {Color:Red}Picori cepel{Color:White}.

en:
Ah, yes. And you've come here now
hoping to have the blade reforged?
Hm... Well, if that's what you're after,
you'll need four mystic {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
These elements are the crystalline
forms of the energies of this world.
Only by {Color:Blue}infusing the blade{Color:White} with these
energies can a new blade be forged.
Here, give me your map. I can mark
where these {Color:Red}elements{Color:White} can be found.
cz:
Aha, ano. A prisli jste sem v
nadeji, ze cepel prekujete?
Hm... Pokud po tom touzite,
budete potrebovat ctyri mysticke {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White}.
Tyto elementy jsou krystalicke
formy energii tohoto sveta.
Jen {Color:Blue}prosycenim cepele{Color:White} temito
energiemi lze ukovat novou cepel.
Dejte mi mapu. Oznacim, kde
se tyto {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White} nachazeji.

en:
The {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White} can be found in the
{Color:Green}shrine{Color:White} to the north of {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}'s abbey.
Speak with {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}. He will show you the
path to the {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White}'s entrance.
Go with caution. Evil creatures have
lately made their home in our {Color:Green}shrine{Color:White}.
Return to me at once after you have
found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}.
cz:
{Color:Red}Element zeme{Color:White} naleznes ve
{Color:Green}svatyni{Color:White} severne od {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}ho opatstvi.
Promluv s {Color:Green}Festari{Color:White}m. Ukaze ti
cestu ke vchodu do {Color:Green}svatyne{Color:White}.
Jdi opatrne. Zle bytosti si
nedavno udelaly domov v nasi {Color:Green}svatyni{Color:White}.
Ihned se ke mne vrat, kdyz
najdes {Color:Red}Element zeme{Color:White}.

en:
{Sound:02:0D}So! You have found the {Color:Red}Earth Element{Color:White}!

You are blessed with much courage and
strength for one so young.
If your conviction holds strong, head
to {Color:Green}Mount Crenel{Color:White}.
There, you will find a man named {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.

Among all the Minish, there is no one
more able to repair your sword.
If you ask him, I am certain he will
reforge your {Color:Red}broken Picori Blade{Color:White}.
I shall send word to him in advance.

Travel safely. You are brave, but
there are many evils now in the world.
cz:
{Sound:02:0D}Tak! Nasel jsi {Color:Red}Element zeme{Color:White}!

Jsi obdaren velkou odvahou a
silou na nekoho tak mladeho.
Jestli tvoje odhodlani vydrzi,
mir k {Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}.
Tam najdes muze jmenem {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}.

Mezi vsemi Minish neni nikdo
schopnejsi opravit tvuj mec.
Kdyz ho pozadas, urcite
prekuje tvou {Color:Red}rozbitou Picori cepel{Color:White}.
Predem mu poslu zpravu.

Cestuj bezpecne. Jsi statecny,
ale na svete je ted mnoho zla.

en:
Leave through this door here. It will
take you out of the forest quickly.
cz:
Odejdi temito dvermi. Rychle
se dostanes z lesa.

Velky starsi, jsme vam zavazani.

Ihned vyrazime k
{Color:Green}Mt. Crenel{Color:White}!

en:
{Sound:00:B0}Come one, come all! See how many
Kinstone pieces you can collect!
You never know what fusing {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White}
will do, but it's sure to be good!
Come on up and get your free {Color:Red}Kinstone
bag{Color:White} for holding your {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White}!
Don't miss out on this incredible,
once-in-a-lifetime opportunity!
cz:
{Sound:00:B0}Pojdte vsichni! Uvidite, kolik
kousku Kamene osudu nasbirate!
Nikdy nevite, co spojeni {Color:Red}Kamenu osudu{Color:White}
zpusobi, ale urcite je to dobre!
Pojdte si pro {Color:Red}pytlik na Kameny{Color:White}
zdarma na nosenie {Color:Red}kousku{Color:White}!
Nenechte si ujit tuhle
neuveritelnou prilezitost!

en:
Yes, yes. You're here for your free
{Color:Red}Kinstone bag{Color:White}, aren't you?
That's right! Maybe you didn't hear me,
but they're free for all kids right now!
cz:
Ano, ano. Jdes si pro {Color:Red}pytlik
na Kameny{Color:White} zdarma, ze?
Spravne! Mozna jsi neslysel,
ale ted jsou pro deti zdarma!

en:
Fitting two {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} together
is called {Color:Blue}Kinstone Fusion{Color:White}.
If you get two pieces to fit perfectly,
great happiness will come your way!
I'll put a {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White} in your
{Color:Red}Kinstone bag{Color:White} so you can give it a try.
{07:12:04}
cz:
Spojeni dvou {Color:Red}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White}
se nazyva {Color:Blue}Spojeni Kamenu{Color:White}.
Kdyz spojis dva kousky perfektne,
potka te velke stesti!
Dam ti {Color:Red}kousek Kamene{Color:White} do
{Color:Red}pytliku{Color:White}, abys to zkusil.
{07:12:04}

en:
Anyone who's ready and willing to {Color:Blue}fuse
Kinstones {Color:White}will look like I do right now.
When you see that look in their eyes,
that's when you press {Key:Left}!
Use {Key:Dpad} to choose a {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White},
and press {Key:A} to try {Color:Blue}fusing it{Color:White}!
Did you catch all of that?
   {Choice:12:05}Yes   {Choice:12:03}No
cz:
Kdokoliv ochotny {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}
bude vypadat jako ja ted.
Kdyz uvidis ten pohled v
jejich ocich, stiskni {Key:Left}!
Pouzij {Key:Dpad} k vyberu {Color:Red}kousku{Color:White}
a stiskni {Key:A} k {Color:Blue}spojeni{Color:White}!
Zachytil jsi vsechno?
   {Choice:12:05}Ano   {Choice:12:03}Ne

en:
Then stand in front of me and press
{Key:Left} so we can {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
cz:
Pak se postav prede me a stiskni
{Key:Left}, at muzeme {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}!

en:
Where are you going? Stand in front of
me and press {Key:Left}!
cz:
Kam jdes? Postav se prede
me a stiskni {Key:Left}!

en:
Yes, yes. That's it. Press {Key:Left}!
Then you can see the {Color:Blue}Kinstone screen{Color:White}.
cz:
Ano, ano. Tak. Stiskni {Key:Left}!
Uvidis {Color:Blue}obrazovku Kamenu{Color:White}.

en:
Hey! What's wrong? Press {Key:Left} so we
can try {Color:Blue}fusing{Color:White} our {Color:Blue}Kinstones{Color:White}.
cz:
Hej! Co se deje? Stiskni {Key:Left},
at muzeme zkusit {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny{Color:White}.

en:
A perfect fit! That means we're both
due for a little happiness! See ya!
cz:
Perfektni shoda! Oba nas
ceka stesti! Mej se!

en:
{Sound:02:07}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
Dig along fer iron!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:02:07}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
Kopej dal pro zelezo!{Symbol:0B}

en:
{Sound:02:0A}This mine belongs to {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White} and
us, his seven apprentices.
Did you ting along, tong along, all this
long way to get your sword repaired?
The {Color:Green}boss{Color:White} is down on the lowest level.
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Tenhle dul patri {Color:Green}Melarimu{Color:White} a
nam, jeho sedmi ucnum.
Prisel jsi tu dlouhou cestu,
abys ti spravili mec?
{Color:Green}Sef{Color:White} je dole na nejnizsim patre.

en:
{Sound:02:0A}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
I'm hmm... Hmm... Hmph!
Man... I really need to come up
with a digging song of my own.
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
Ja hmm... Hmm... Hmf!
Clovece... Vazne si musim
vymyslet vlastni dolovaci pisen.

en:
{Sound:02:0A}If you head outside from here, you
can go see the {Color:Green}mine{Color:White} the humans dug.
But the {Color:Green}boss{Color:White} doesn't let anyone go
in there without permission.
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Kdyz pujdes ven, muzes videt
{Color:Green}dul{Color:White}, ktery vykopali lide.
Ale {Color:Green}sef{Color:White} tam nikoho nepousti
bez dovoleni.

en:
{Sound:02:0A}What? You're going to the {Color:Green}mine{Color:White}?

If you've talked to the {Color:Green}boss{Color:White}, I won't
stop you. But be careful.
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Co? Ty jdes do {Color:Green}dolu{Color:White}?

Jestli jsi mluvil se {Color:Green}sefem{Color:White},
nezastavim te. Ale opatrne.

en:
{Sound:02:09}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
Huh, what? Who am I?
Why, my lad, I'm the second-best of
the Minish metalsmiths!
I'm makin' swords with the boss.
cz:
{Sound:02:09}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
He, co? Kdo jsem?
Mily hochu, jsem druhy nejlepsi
z Minish kovaru!
Delam mece se sefem.

en:
{Sound:02:06}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
Huh, what? Who am I?
Well, I'm no less than the third-
best of the Minish metalsmiths!
I'm makin' swords with the boss.
cz:
{Sound:02:06}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
He, co? Kdo jsem?
Jsem nic mene nez treti nejlepsi
z Minish kovaru!
Delam mece se sefem.

en:
{Sound:02:0A}Oh! You made it back safely! Fantastic!
We were all starting to get worried.
I think your {Color:Red}sword{Color:White} might be ready.

The boss was just putting the finishing
touches on it a second ago.
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Ach! Vratil jsi se bezpecne!
Fantasticke! Uz jsme se zacinali bat.
Myslim, ze tvuj {Color:Red}mec{Color:White} je hotov.

Sef ho prave dokoncoval
pred chvili.

en:
{Sound:02:06}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
The sacred sword is done!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:02:06}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
Posvatny mec je hotov!{Symbol:0B}

en:
{04:10:00}The {Color:Green}sanctuary {Color:White}is a strange place that
borders the human and Minish worlds.
The doorway to the {Color:Green}sanctuary {Color:White}opens
only once every hundred years.
I believe the entrance is somewhere
in {Color:Green}Hyrule Castle{Color:White}.
cz:
{04:10:00}{Color:Green}Svatyne {Color:White}je podivne misto, ktere
spojuje lidsky a Minish svet.
Dvere do {Color:Green}svatyne {Color:White}se otevirou
jen jednou za sto let.
Verim, ze vchod je nekde
v {Color:Green}hrade Hyrule{Color:White}.

en:
Oh! Do you have a {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White}?
Well, come on! Let's {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
cz:
Ach! Mas {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White}?
Pojd! Pojdme {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny{Color:White}!

en: Oh, had a change of heart, have we?
cz: Ach, rozmyslel sis to?

en:
Oh! Yes! They fit together! A perfect
match! It's such a satisfying sight!
cz:
Ach! Ano! Sednou! Dokonala
shoda! Je to uspokojivy pohled!

en: I dug up a {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White} near here.
cz: Vykopal jsem tu {Color:Red}kousek Kamene{Color:White}.

en: Want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White} with me?
cz: Chces se mnou {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?

en: Oh, so now you don't?
cz: Ach, ted nechces?

en:
Lookee there! Our pieces fused
together!
I wonder what it means... Maybe I'll
dig up some really strong iron!
cz:
Podivej! Nase kousky se
spojily!
Co to asi znamena... Mozna
vykopu opravdu silne zelezo!

en:
{Sound:02:0A}Ting along, tong along!{Symbol:0B}
Diggin' holes for {Color:Red}Kinstones{Color:White}!{Symbol:0B}
cz:
{Sound:02:0A}Ting tonk, tong tonk!{Symbol:0B}
Kopu diry pro {Color:Red}Kameny osudu{Color:White}!{Symbol:0B}

en: Want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White} with me?
cz: Chces se mnou {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?

en:
No? You don't want to?
Fine. Whatever.
cz:
Ne? Nechces?
Dobre. Jak chces.

en:
Yes! A perfect fit! Maybe now I can be
just like my dad!
cz:
Ano! Dokonala shoda! Mozna ted
muzu byt jako tata!

en:
Y'know, iron's not the only thing
we dig up around here.
We've been known to find quite
a few {Color:Red}Kinstone pieces{Color:White} as well.
cz:
Vis, zelezo neni jedina vec,
co tu vykopavame.
Obcas najdeme i hodne
{Color:Red}kousku Kamene osudu{Color:White}.

en: Want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White} with me?
cz: Chces se mnou {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?

en:
If you find some more pieces, come on
back. I'm sure I'll dig up a bunch!
cz:
Kdyz najdes vic kousku, vrat
se. Urcite jich vykopu spoustu!

en:
Incredible! A perfect match! I can't
wait to see what will happen to me!
cz:
Neuveritelne! Dokonala shoda!
Nemuzu se dockat, co se mi stane!

en: Want to fuse Kinstones with me?
cz: Chces se mnou spojit Kameny osudu?

en: Let's fuse Kinstones again sometime.
cz: Spojme Kameny osudu zase nekdy.

en:
Whoa! They fused together!
I'm gonna tell everybody!
cz:
Pani! Spojily se!
Reknu to vsem!

en: Wanna {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}?
cz: Chces {Color:Blue}spojit Kameny osudu{Color:White}?

en: We're gonna {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstones{Color:White}!
cz: Spojime {Color:Blue}Kameny osudu{Color:White}!

en: {Color:Blue}Fusing Kinstones{Color:White} is a blast!
cz: {Color:Blue}Spojovani Kamenu osudu{Color:White} je zabava!

en:
{Sound:02:0C}{04:10:0E}Green clothes? And an odd hat?!?
Sir! Might you be young {Player}?
I am {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}, master smith.

I hear you want me to reforge the
{Color:Red}sacred sword{Color:White} and help break a curse.
I'll be needin' the old sword, which
holds the power of the {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}, first.
Show me that {Color:Red}broken Picori Blade{Color:White}!

I love all this adventure, what with
the rescuing of princesses and such.
I'd be happy to reforge this thing into
a brand-new sacred blade for you.
cz:
{Sound:02:0C}{04:10:0E}Zelene saty? A divny klobouk?!?
Pane! Nejste mladsi {Player}?
Jsem {Color:Green}Melari{Color:White}, mistr kovar.

Slysim, ze chces, abych prekoval
{Color:Red}posvatny mec{Color:White} a pomohl zlomit kletbu.
Nejdriv budu potrebovat stary mec,
ktery drzi silu {Color:Red}elementu{Color:White}.
Ukaz mi tu {Color:Red}rozbitou Picori cepel{Color:White}!

Mam rad dobrodruzstvi se zachranou
princeznam a takove vecicky.
Rad ti to prekuju v zbrusu
novou posvatnou cepel.

en:
{04:10:00}It'll take me a while to rework
your sword.
In the meantime, you should track down
the missing {Color:Red}elements{Color:White}.
One of them should be in the {Color:Green}mine{Color:White} the
humans dug. It's not far from here.
cz:
{04:10:00}Bude mi chvili trvat predelat
tvuj mec.
Mezitim by ses mel vydat za
chybejicimi {Color:Red}elementy{Color:White}.
Jeden by mel byt v {Color:Green}dolu{Color:White}, ktery
vykopali lide. Neni to daleko.

en: {04:10:00}All right! Let's get started!
cz: {04:10:00}Dobre! Pojdme na to!

en:
{Sound:00:92}They'll be a while, {Player}. Let's
leave them to it and find that {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!
cz:
{Sound:00:92}Bude to chvili trvat, {Player}.
Nechme je byt a najdeme ten {Color:Red}element{Color:White}!

en:
{04:10:0E}I'm the {Color:Green}Crenel hermit{Color:White}. I left the world
to pursue a life of quiet reflection.
You seem to be but a child, and yet you
climbed this forbidding mountain alone?
I must reward your courage with a
little information.
Have you not seen strange patterned
walls as you climbed this mountain?
{Color:Red}Bombs{Color:White}! Bombs are the answer!
cz:
{04:10:0E}Jsem {Color:Green}Crenel poustevnik{Color:White}. Opustil jsem
svet kvuli zivotu tiche reflexe.
Zdas se byt jen dite, a presto
jsi vylezl na tuto horu sam?
Musim ti tvou odvahu odmenit
trochou informaci.
Nevidel jsi divne vzorovane
zdi pri vystupu na horu?
{Color:Red}Bomby{Color:White}! Bomby jsou odpoved!

en:
I have an old {Color:Red}Kinstone piece{Color:White} that I
dug up somewhere around here.
Do you want to {Color:Blue}fuse Kinstone pieces{Color:White}?
Oh, yeah!   Maybe later
cz:
Mam stary {Color:Red}kousek Kamene osudu{Color:White},
co jsem vykopal nekde tady.
Chces {Color:Blue}spojit kousky Kamenu{Color:White}?
O ano!   Mozna pozdeji
